2607.19620.title: SCPP: A Unified Python Library for Soft Clustering
2607.19620.paper_summary: In this paper, we present SCPP (Soft Clustering Python Package), an open-source Python framework for soft clustering. SCPP establishes a canonical, scikit-learn-compatible estimator interface that standardizes model training, prediction, membership representation, evaluation, and benchmarking across heterogeneous soft clustering methods, including fuzzy, probabilistic, graph-based, matrix factorization, and deep learning methods. The framework currently integrates 40 representative algorithms together with a comprehensive benchmarking comprising datasets, clustering quality metrics, and standardized runtime, memory, and scalability evaluation. SCPP further provides extensive documentation, practical examples, automated testing, and seamless integration with the scientific Python ecosystem, enabling reproducible experimentation and straightforward extension with new algorithms. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/soft-clustering/soft-clustering.
2607.19620.paper_summary_zh: 在本文中，我們介紹了 SCPP（軟聚類 Python 套件），這是一個開源的 Python 框架，用於軟聚類。<lb/>SCPP 建立了一個標準的、與 scikit-learn 兼容的估計器介面，統一了模型訓練、預測、成員表示、評估和基準測試，涵蓋了包括模糊、概率、基於圖的、矩陣分解和深度學習方法在內的異質軟聚類方法。<lb/>該框架目前整合了 40 種具有代表性的算法，以及一個全面的基準測試，包括數據集、聚類質量指標，以及標準化的運行時間、內存和可擴展性評估。<lb/>SCPP 還提供了廣泛的文檔、實用示例、自動測試，並與科學 Python 生態系統無縫集成，使得可重複的實驗和新算法的簡單擴展成為可能。<lb/>源代碼可在 https://github.com/soft-clustering/soft-clustering 上公開獲得。
